title: fix: login fails on Safari when cookies are blocked
author: asha
description:
## Steps to reproduce

1. Block third-party cookies in Safari
2. Visit /login
3. Submit credentials

## Expected

User is logged in.

## Actual

Redirect loop between /login and /auth/callback.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Login completes without third-party cookies
- [ ] No redirect loop on Safari 17+
- [ ] Test added
